studio.toolsCompanion.navigator.title: i-canvas navigator
studio.toolsCompanion.navigator.descript: Hlola indawo yamanje yokubuka ekubukeni kuqala bese uchofoza noma uhudule ukuze uhambise ikhanvasi.
studio.toolsCompanion.navigator.liveAria: Hambisa indawo ebonakalayo ekuhloleni kuqala kwekhanvasi
studio.toolsCompanion.navigator.readySub: Uma uxhumano nokuthwebula sekulungile, ikhanvasi yamanje izovela lapha.
studio.toolsCompanion.screenPlacement.un: Lesi siphequluli asikusekeli ukubekwa kwewindi okuzenzakalelayo. Ihambise mathupha ngokuhudula ibha yesihloko sewindi.
studio.toolsCompanion.screenPlacement.no: Angikwazanga ukuthola ezinye izikrini ezitholakalayo. Sicela uhlole isimo sokuxhuma kwesikrini.
studio.toolsCompanion.screenPlacement.de: Idinga izimvume zokuphatha iwindi. Sicela uvumele imvume kuzilungiselelo zesayithi kubha yekheli noma uyihambise ngqo.
studio.toolsCompanion.screenPlacement.ti: Alukho ulwazi lwesikrini olutholiwe. Sicela uzame futhi noma uhudule ibha yesihloko sewindi ukuze uyisuse.
studio.toolsCompanion.screenPlacement.fa: Isicelo sokususa isikrini sihlulekile. Ihambise mathupha ngokuhudula ibha yesihloko sewindi.
studio.toolsCompanion.screenPlacement.re: Kubuyiselwe indawo yewindi nosayizi abalondolozwe le ndima.
studio.toolsCompanion.screenPlacement.st: Ukucushwa kwemonitha kushintshile futhi kwamisa ukubuyisela okuzenzakalelayo. Hambisa iwindi endaweni oyifunayo bese uchofoza okuthi ‘Gcina indawo yamanje.’
studio.toolsCompanion.presentationSafe.n: Iyeke ukuthumela ukuhlola kuqala kwekhanvasi kanye nama-URL esithombe akhululiwe kumemori yesiphequluli.
studio.toolsCompanion.presentationSafe.r: Sifihle isithombe esiyisethenjwa kanye nombala osanda kukhethwa, futhi sacima ne-URL yokubuka kuqala kumemori yesiphequluli.
studio.toolsCompanion.layoutSettings.per: Ukuze uvumele ukubuyisela okuzenzakalelayo, chofoza okuthi ‘Hambisa iwindi kwesinye isikrini’ phezulu kanye ukuze uvumele imvume yokuphatha iwindi.
Ukubuyisela ngokuzenzakalela akwenzeki ngoba izimvume zokuphatha iwindi zivaliwe. Sicela uvule imvume kuzilungiselelo zesayithi yesiphequluli sakho noma uyihambise ngqo.
studio.toolsCompanion.layoutSettings.sta: Ukulungiselelwa kwemonitha bekuhlukile kunangesikhathi silondolozwa, ngakho-ke akuzange kuhanjiswe kusikrini esingahleliwe. Yihambise endaweni oyifunayo bese uchofoza okuthi 'Londoloza Indawo Yamanje'.
studio.toolsCompanion.layoutSettings.res: Isiphequluli asizange siphoqelele ukunyakaza kwewindi, sigcine ukubekwa kokulondoloza okukhona. Uma uzihambisa ngokwakho iwindi, lizokhumbula indawo yalo yangempela futhi.
studio.toolsCompanion.footer: Hlela amadokhumenti ungumnikazi wethebhu yokuzenzakalelayo kuphela. Leli windi lidlulisela kuphela ukubuka kuqala okucindezelwe kanye nenjongo yokuhlola/yereferensi ku-BroadcastChannel yesiphequluli esifanayo, ngakho azikho izindleko zeseva ezihlukile.
studio.toolsCompanion.exit.disconnected: Not connected to the main Studio.
